description: Change properties, attributes and tags of one or more instances. One undo step. Values are plain JSON and are converted to the property's own type: Vector3 [x,y,z], Vector2 [x,y], Color3 "#RRGGBB" or [r,g,b] (0-255), CFrame {"position":[x,y,z],"rotation":[rx,ry,rz]} in degrees (or just [x,y,z] to move it), UDim2 [xScale,xOffset,yScale,yOffset], enums by name ("Neon"), BrickColor by name, instances by path.

path.description: Instance path such as "game.Workspace.Model.Part" or "game.ServerScriptService.Main". Services are found by name. Use paths instead to change several at once.

paths.description: Several instance paths that all get the same changes.

properties.description: Property name to new value, e.g. {"Anchored": true, "Size": [4,1,2], "Material": "Neon", "Name": "Floor", "Parent": "game.Workspace.Map"}.

name: studio_set_properties
